fact: State Minister Zerihun Kebede said the national monitoring and evaluation platform, used by more than 113 public institutions, is designed to support institutions with real-time, AI-powered insights for policymaking.

The ATI with COSS and Protean eGov announced on 3 February 2026 the launch of Ethiopia OpenAgriNet, an AI-powered agricultural digital public infrastructure with location-specific AI recommendations, meant to reach millions of farmers by 2032, with ATI as first implementing partner.

The Ethiopian Institute of Artificial Intelligence inaugurated customs systems for the Customs Commission, including a passenger risk management system and a licensing system with a chatbot serving the Commission's services in four languages (TechReviewAfrica).

The Ministry of Justice and the Ethiopian AI Institute signed a work contract to develop an integrated criminal justice system, which the AI Institute is to deliver within one year, and the state minister says the justice system must be supported by AI.

Addis Fortune reports the Federal Supreme Court's automatic transcription software, developed with the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute, was delivered for 15.8 million Br, with five smart courtrooms installed at the Federal Supreme Court and ten more in the Federal High and First Instance Courts.
Addis Fortune reports that the Ministry of Revenues and the Ethiopian Customs Commission unveiled an AI-powered Passenger Risk Management System among eight digital systems on 12 October 2025.

IDinsight says HEP Assist, built by Last Mile Health with Ethiopia's Ministry of Health, is launched in five regions and operating, with call agents using an LLM assistant to answer health extension workers' clinical queries.

IDinsight reports that 19 Ministry of Health experts rated 91.2% of HEP Assist responses above average across 580 questions, and an endline survey as of 2025 found 83.3% medical accuracy in real-world use.
Birr Metrics reports the Ministry of Education has completed testing in selected schools of an AI-powered teacher assistant for grades 9-12 and will begin national deployment.

The Ministry of Health with Last Mile Health held a forum introducing the implementation phase of HEP Assist, an AI tool supporting health extension workers, built only on 100 validated ministry clinical guidelines.

The Reporter says the Ministry of Health and Last Mile Health launched HEP Assist, an AI assistant drawing on 100 Ministry of Health guidelines, piloted in 15 woredas across seven regions to support health extension workers, with over 6,000 consultations since January 2025 and scale-up to all woredas planned after evaluation.

CGIAR reports that the HaFAS fertilizer advisory system, run by Ethiopia's Ministry of Agriculture and EIAR and using AI and machine learning analytics, gave farm-specific recommendations to 49,000 farmers in 2025 and is being adopted in the national extension system.
CGIAR reports that HaFAS raised wheat yields by 16-25 percent and maize yields by 10.5-17.6 percent among participating farmers in 2025, and cut input costs by 20 percent.

Education Minister Berhanu Nega says Ethiopia has begun integrating AI into the education system, with teachers supported to use AI tools for lesson preparation, content development, student support and assessment.
The Conversation's authors say Ethiopia and Rwanda used AI in TB and cervical cancer screening, in a regulatory vacuum.
